bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 60
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:startless-batch-db17)" || exit 61
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 62
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations WHERE state='applied';")" = 50 || exit 63
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations WHERE state='uncertain';")" = 10 || exit 64
before="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||message_id||':'||owner_user_id FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,message_id;")" || exit 65
for n in 1 2;do
 set +e
 result="$(docker exec deploy-gaybbs-1 node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/refreshStartlessExistingPosts.mjs --apply 2>&1)"
 rc=$?
 set -e
 printf '%s\n' "$result" | tail -n 7
 echo BATCH_INDEX="$n" EXIT="$rc"
 test "$rc" = 0 || exit 70
 printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"selected":15' || exit 71
 printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"applied":15' || exit 72
 printf '%s\n' "$result" | grep -Fq '"uncertain":0' || exit 73
done
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations WHERE state='applied';")" = 80 || exit 74
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations WHERE state='uncertain';")" = 10 || exit 75
after="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||':'||message_id||':'||owner_user_id FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0 ORDER BY chat_id,message_id;")" || exit 76
test "$before" = "$after" || exit 77
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 78
echo STARTLESS_APPLIED=80
echo STARTLESS_UNCERTAIN=10
echo PUBLIC_MESSAGE_DELETIONS=NONE
